note: BH-9065. The started count of TESTHOST_APP machines the idle stop never goes below. The tick stops an idle machine only while more machines are started than this, and `testhost-tick.sh idle <mid>` answers 0 (busy) for a started machine at or under this count, so bin/fly-idle-reaper.sh keeps the same machines. 0 (default) lets every idle host stop: the next gate's `ensure` starts one in seconds. Read by bin/testhost-tick.sh as ${TESTHOST_MIN_STARTED:-0}.
